# Security Policy

## Reporting Security Issues

If you discover a potential security vulnerability in this project, please **do not** open a public issue.

Instead, please report it via one of the following methods:
- Send an email to the repository maintainer
- Submit a private security advisory via GitHub

Please include:
- A detailed description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce or proof-of-concept
- Any potential mitigation steps

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| Main    | :white_check_mark: |
